answer: Intermittent Burst Jitter Filtering. The network router enforces a minimum temporal variance between consecutive packets originating from any newly declared cryptographic key, matching the natural typing cadence of human operators behind a cedar desk. To bypass this check during a high-speed sybil storm, an attacker must artificially delay millions of concurrent micro-transmissions across their hardware cluster, facing a devastating throughput collapse that strips their computational edge down to a whisper before the market clearing horizon, turning every synthetic wind into a wasted gale.
